paper_title: First results of the CERN Resonant WISP Search (CROWS)
notes: Microwave LSW experiment (CROWS) at CERN. Reports both ALP (g=4.5e-8 GeV^-1 at m_a=7.2 ueV) and hidden sector photon (chi=4.1e-9 at m_gamma'=10.8 ueV) limits at 95% CL. The HSP/dark photon result probes previously unexplored parameter space; this is reported as kinetic mixing chi (DarkPhoton). The ALP result (AxionPhoton g) is also given. Only the single most sensitive point per channel is quoted in text; full exclusion curves are in Figs 13/14 but not tabulated. LSW experiment, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumed.
